title: Deferred Comp 457(b) Comparison
description: Compare a 457(b) deferral against a taxable account across your current and retirement marginal rates, growth horizon and long-term capital gains rate. Outputs both ending balances, level after-tax withdrawals over the drawdown, the total and present-value advantage, the break-even retirement rate, and which scenario wins. Names the smallest 2026 limit tier that would permit the deferral. Port of ApexLogics Apex #44 / AL-49 (page https://apexlogics.org/tools/44-deferred-comp-457b-engine/ fetched 2026-11-19, 50657 bytes, sha256 ecbd4c8436218c46afdf7e5ef03949fcff809c52f66d467ffefefced0bac5707). Arithmetic over declared figures, not tax advice; plan rules vary and the plan document governs.

annual_income_usd.description: Annual W-2 income in USD, 0 to 1,000,000,000. Echoed only; no result depends on it.

deferral_usd.description: Annual 457(b) deferral in USD, 0 to 49,000. Zero is a valid deferral. Above 24,500 the DEFERRAL_ABOVE_STANDARD_LIMIT flag is raised.

current_rate_pct.description: Current marginal tax rate in percent, 0 to 60 (federal plus state combined as entered).

retirement_rate_pct.description: Expected marginal tax rate on retirement withdrawals in percent, 0 to 60.

growth_rate_pct.description: Annual growth rate in percent, 0 to 20, applied to the 457(b) and used as the NPV discount rate.

withdrawal_years.description: Drawdown period in whole years, 5 to 40.

taxable_return_pct.description: Annual return of the taxable account in percent, 0 to 20, net of dividend drag.

capital_gains_rate_pct.description: Long-term capital gains rate in percent, 0 to 40, applied to the taxable account gain at liquidation.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_deferred_comp_457b
mcp_tool_definition.description: Compare deferring into a 457(b) against taking the pay and investing in a taxable account: both ending balances, level after-tax withdrawals, total and present-value advantage, the break-even retirement rate and a FAVORS_457B or FAVORS_TAXABLE verdict, plus the smallest 2026 limit tier that permits the deferral. Refuses missing, null, mistyped or out-of-range inputs. Reads no clock. Arithmetic over declared figures, not tax advice.

annual_income_usd.description: Annual W-2 income in USD, 0 to 1,000,000,000. Echoed only; no result depends on it.

deferral_usd.description: Annual 457(b) deferral in USD, 0 to 49,000. Zero is a valid deferral. Above 24,500 the DEFERRAL_ABOVE_STANDARD_LIMIT flag is raised.

current_rate_pct.description: Current marginal tax rate in percent, 0 to 60 (federal plus state combined as entered).

retirement_rate_pct.description: Expected marginal tax rate on retirement withdrawals in percent, 0 to 60.

growth_rate_pct.description: Annual growth rate in percent, 0 to 20, applied to the 457(b) and used as the NPV discount rate.

withdrawal_years.description: Drawdown period in whole years, 5 to 40.

taxable_return_pct.description: Annual return of the taxable account in percent, 0 to 20, net of dividend drag.

capital_gains_rate_pct.description: Long-term capital gains rate in percent, 0 to 40, applied to the taxable account gain at liquidation.

valid_input.description: False when any input was refused; the scenarios are then null.

domain_errors.description: One REFUSED_INPUT_* entry per violated bound.

inputs.description: Echo of the nine inputs exactly as given (raw, never rounded); null for a refused value.

limits_used.description: The declared 2026 limit constants the tier comparison used.

limit_tier.description: Smallest limit tier that would permit the deferral; eligibility is not tested.

scenario_a.description: The 457(b) path: tax saved now, balance at retirement, level annual after-tax withdrawal, total after tax and NPV, all USD at 2dp.

scenario_b.description: The taxable path: investable cash, gross balance, balance after gains tax, level annual withdrawal, total after tax and NPV, all USD at 2dp.

advantage.description: total_usd and npv_usd (A minus B), break_even_retirement_rate_pct (4dp, clamped 0 to 100) and the verdict.

warnings.description: Mirror of the conditional compliance flags.

author: PostOakLabs

output_example.note: Scenario A defers the amount pre-tax and grows it at growth_rate_pct, taxed at retirement_rate_pct on withdrawal. Scenario B invests deferral x (1 - current rate) in a taxable account at taxable_return_pct, with capital_gains_rate_pct on the gain at liquidation. Withdrawals are level over withdrawal_years and discounted at growth_rate_pct for the NPV figures. break_even_retirement_rate_pct = 100 x (1 - taxable net / deferral balance), clamped to 0..100. Arithmetic over declared figures; not tax advice, and the plan document governs.
